packageRules.description: Workflow actions: no major updates by bot (as with Dependabot)
Application and library modules must move AGP major versions together: do it by hand. Gradle plugins carry the marker artifact as packageName, so match the plugin id by depName
Wrapper updates rewrite launchers and a binary JAR: run the wrapper task deliberately instead
lizard 1.24 parses Kotlin differently and finds ~550 functions 1.23 skipped, 15 over the CCN 10 gate; hold it until those are refactored or the gate is re-baselined
Guava publishes -android and -jre flavours; this is an Android app, so stay on -android
